threshold_note: Every sample matches at PSNR 36-44 dB (frame, crop, push, settle and callouts). SSIM sits at 0.885-0.893 at every sample, not only during the moves: the 800x500 static BT.709 clip (evidence-static.mp4) is cropped to 9:16 about x 30%, so Chrome upscales about 3.8x and filters the <video> differently in each renderer, the same cause as d-evidence-clip and b-media-window-video with more upscaling. A moving testsrc would add seek lag (a different decoded frame per renderer), so the fixture uses the static clip.
